findings.location: Star rating icons under each book thumbnail in the product grid
findings.issue: The yellow fill color of the stars has extremely poor contrast against the white background, failing the WCAG AA minimum contrast ratio of 3:1 for user interface components and graphical objects.
findings.user_impact: Users with low vision or those viewing the site in high-glare environments will struggle to distinguish the star ratings, making it difficult to assess product quality.
findings.recommendation: Change the star icon color to a darker amber/gold shade (such as #c2410c or #d97706) or add a dark gray 1px outline around each star to ensure sufficient contrast against the white background.

findings.location: Left sidebar category list links (e.g., 'Travel', 'Mystery', 'Historical Fiction')
findings.issue: The light blue text links are displayed on a light gray sidebar container background. The contrast ratio is insufficient, failing the WCAG AA threshold of 4.5:1 for normal text.
findings.user_impact: Visually impaired users will find it highly difficult to read the category list, restricting their ability to navigate and filter the bookstore by genre.
findings.recommendation: Increase the contrast of the sidebar text links by using a darker blue or teal hex code (e.g., #0e4b5c) and increase the font size slightly to 14px to improve legibility.

findings.location: Book title text links in the main product grid
findings.issue: Book titles are aggressively truncated to a single line with an ellipsis (e.g., 'A Light in the ...', 'Sapiens: A Brief History ...'), even though there is plenty of vertical space available in the card layout.
findings.user_impact: Users cannot read the full name of the books without clicking into the detail pages, which slows down the browsing experience and increases cognitive load.
findings.recommendation: Allow the book titles to wrap to a maximum of two lines before truncating. Set a fixed height for the title container to prevent layout shifting and maintain grid alignment.
